summary: Summit Therapeutics Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on July 23, 2026, relating to an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $380 million of its common stock under an existing shelf registration. The shares will be sold through J.P. Morgan Securities LLC as sales agent on The Nasdaq Global Market at prevailing market prices (last closing $14.74). The agent receives a 3.0% commission. This is a routine equity distribution arrangement, not a special situation. There are no fixed terms, premium, or structural triggers; no board recommendation or advisor; watch for periodic sales disclosures but no risk-arb angle.
